# Retrieve the hotel search results with the specified amenities (pool and gym) and budget
hotels_with_amenities = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=get_results_from_cache(key="hotels"),
    gym_present=True,
    pool_present=True,
    budget=85,
    checkin_date=["2025-12-31", "2025-12-31"],
    checkout_date=["2026-01-09", "2026-01-09"]
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels_with_amenities", value=hotels_with_amenities)

# Retrieve the restaurant search results for Finnish cuisine with a 4.0 rating
restaurants_finnish = get_results_from_cache(key="restaurants")

# Filter the restaurants to match the 4.0 rating requirement
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(
    prior_results=restaurants_finnish,
    rating=[4.0, 4.0]
)

# Save the filtered restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Find the nearest restaurants to the hotels with the specified amenities
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels_with_amenities,
    restaurants=filtered_restaurants,
    groupBy="restaurant"
)

# Save the nearest restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_restaurants", value=nearest_restaurants)

# Output the query summary
print("No planning needed")
